messages:
Mia (SEO): Quick sync — prepping launch posts + webinar landing. Need a short URL hygiene field guide before we push. Main asks: canonical decisions, query-param stripping, CTA UTM scheme, and internal-link plan. Thoughts?
Aj: I can draft canonical rules. Can we standardize trailing slash behavior across blog & docs? :thinking_face:
Sam P: Agree on a standard. Prefer no-trailing-slash for blog. We'll need 301s for existing pages that currently use a trailing slash and canonical tags on paginated lists.
Nora - Content: I'll map CTAs and landing paths. For webinars we should lock utm_source=launch and utm_campaign=webinar_mar24. Can we reserve the exact param names so analytics is clean?
Kevin (Dev): We can add middleware to strip session params and inject canonical Link headers. Where do you want the redirect/mapping stored? YAML in the marketing repo?
Mia (SEO): Yes — single source of truth in marketing repo under /seo/url-rules.yaml. Sam, can you own the redirect rules PR? Also add the schema checklist: event markup for webinar, webinarSchedule, and FAQPage where applicable.
Sam P: Yep. Adding to my queue. Quick snippet for canonical header middleware: ```
res.set('Link', '<' + canonicalUrl + '>; rel="canonical"')
```
I'll open a PR and include unit tests for param stripping.
Aj: Tiny ask — ensure internal linking follows topic-cluster guidance: product -> pillar blog -> supporting posts. Use follow links and add `data-link-type` attributes so we can track anchor performance in the launch funnel.
Nora - Content: I'll annotate the draft posts with suggested anchor text and target URLs. Sharing the doc in #marketing-drafts shortly.
seo-bot: Reminder: run site crawl after PR merge. Last full crawl 2024-03-10, 412 warnings open.
Mia (SEO): Can we aim to have these rules live before next Wednesday's webinar? I want a short checklist in the launch playbook so AE and comms teams can verify.
Kevin (Dev): ETA: middleware + redirect PR by Tue EOD if nothing else blocks.
Sam P: :thumbsup: I'll draft the PR and add test cases for param stripping + a smoke test for canonical headers.
Aj: :eyes: I'll review the canonical rules and cluster links once PR is up.
Mia (SEO): Thanks team — I'll assemble the checklist and publish to the launch playbook. Ping me if anything slips or you need examples for schema markup.
